title: The Last Day
sceneText:
The thirtieth of October.

You wake before it is properly light and there is frost outside the window. There has been frost every day this week.

There is already movement downstairs, no earlier than usual and no later. Martha is in the kitchen, Gregor is in the stable, the people in the fields went out long ago.

Today is no different from yesterday. What has to be done today is the same set of things that had to be done yesterday.

Only: once today is done, will there be a tomorrow?

variants.elena_distant: As you come down, Elena is wiping the stair rail. She sees you and turns side-on to let you pass.
variants.elena_close:
As you come down, Elena is carrying a great roll of something out towards the yard.

The winter quilts. She takes them out one at a time and lays them over the rail along the yard wall to air.

Today is the thirtieth of October.

Those quilts will not be wanted until the middle of November. She did not ask anybody whether they should be aired now.
